detail:
A SECLUDED HILLSIDE IN THE HEART OF ULUWATU
Uluwatu Hills is a boutique collection of just seventeen villas on a 2,500 m² jungle hillside in Pecatu, on Bali's Bukit peninsula. The land sits within the area's tourism (pariwisata) zone, and the villas step down the slope across five terraced levels so each one keeps an open outlook over the canopy, with the Indian Ocean on the horizon. Six Senses and Bvlgari Resort are around two minutes away; Bingin, Padang Padang and Melasti beaches, Sundays Beach Club and Savaya are within roughly 7–15 minutes.

ARCHITECTURE & MATERIALS
The architecture is calm and tactile: limewashed walls, breeze-block screens, skylights and cascading planting that pulls the jungle right into the living spaces. Materials were chosen to suit Bali's climate and age well — locally sourced ulin timber decking, black lava stone, Sukabumi pool tiles and granite floors. Living areas open fully onto a private pool deck, kitchens are finished in stone and timber, and bathrooms centre on freestanding stone tubs and rain showers. The estate has 24/7 security and reception.

THE VILLAS
Two-Bedroom Premium (Levels 1–2) — two storeys, 2 bedrooms / 3 bathrooms, 130 m² living area, 22 m² pool
Two-Bedroom Deluxe (Level 3) — 2 bedrooms / 2 bathrooms, 74 m² living area, 15 m² pool
One-Bedroom (Levels 4–5) — 1 bedroom / 1 bathroom, 58 m² living area, 12 m² pool

PRICES & AVAILABILITY
11 of the 17 villas are currently available:
Two-Bedroom Premium, Level 1 — villas 1 and 2 (135 m² land) — $360,000
Two-Bedroom Premium, Level 2 — villas 4 (135 m² land) and 6 (131 m² land) — $310,000
Two-Bedroom Deluxe, Level 3 — villas 7 (137 m² land) and 9 (142 m² land) — $235,000
One-Bedroom, Level 4 — villas 12 (102 m² land) and 13 (114 m² land) — $185,000
One-Bedroom, Level 5 — villas 14 (113 m² land), 15 (103 m² land) and 16 (120 m² land) — $185,000
Availability changes quickly — ask us for the current plan. Prices are subject to change — please check the latest price with us.

INVESTMENT
Villas are delivered fully furnished and fully managed. The developer's projections, at 65–85% occupancy, put net returns at roughly 11.5–15.0% for the One-Bedroom (around $150 a night), 12.1–15.8% for the Two-Bedroom Deluxe (around $200) and 11.5–15.0% for the Two-Bedroom Premium (around $270), after operating costs, booking fees and management — a payback of about 6.3–8.7 years. Projections are indicative, not guaranteed.

TENURE & PAYMENT PLAN
The contract fixes a 30-year leasehold, with an option to extend for a further 30 years; the extension carries an additional fee set according to the land's market price at the time. Payments are staged with construction: 10% refundable reservation, 30% on signing the lease agreement, 20% on completion of foundation works, 20% at 30% progress, 15% at 60% progress and 5% on key handover.

KEY FACTS
Location: Pecatu, Uluwatu — Bukit peninsula, south Bali
Tourism (pariwisata) zoning · 2,500 m² estate
17 private pool villas across five terraced levels — 11 available
One- and two-bedroom layouts, 58–130 m² living area
Fully furnished & fully managed · 24/7 security and reception
Leasehold: 30 years + optional 30-year extension (additional fee at land market price)
Delivery: Q2 2028
From $185,000 — prices are subject to change — please check the latest price with us.
